items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Uncle Joe, too, used to play.

ctx.x: Is he still around? Yeah, on the magazine street. What is that Italian holiday that they paraded over there? Oh, it's in St. Rosalie. St. Rosalie. St. Rosalie. Man, he called me up for a parade. I think we must have walked up about 40 miles. He can't?
Yeah. Well, old man, Carazard, used to play in the band. Uncle Joe, too, used to play.
And some of these guys were walking in barricade carrying big buckets of rocks in each hand for a penance, man. You know they must have done something bad. What's the matter?
